external_desc: RESOLVED: Firebase Cloud Messaging - low availability in North America

updates.text: The problem has been resolved. All services in scope are back to normal.
Services are recovering. Next update at 05:30

We're aware of a problem with Firebase Cloud Messaging affecting its availability and latency in North America. We will provide an update by 04:30AM detailing when we expect to resolve the problem. Please note that this resolution time is an estimate and may change.

most_recent_update.text: The problem has been resolved. All services in scope are back to normal.

external_desc: Firebase Hosting is experiencing slightly elevated 502 errors on requests for dynamic content

updates.text: Requests for dynamic content from Firebase Hosting (rewrites to Cloud Run & Functions, POST requests to Firebase Auth) are experiencing slightly elevated rates of 502 errors.
